errors.evidence: The description states that the x-axis tick interval is 1, but the axis labels (1, 3, 5, 7, etc.) clearly show an interval of 2.
The description states that the y-axis tick interval is 1, but the axis labels (0, 2, 4, 6, 8, 10) clearly show an interval of 2. This is the second instance of this phrase in the description.
The description states the starting value at x=1 is approximately 9, but the data point is much closer to 10 (around 9.8).
The description states the value at x=3 is approximately 6.5, but the data point is clearly below 6, at approximately 5.7.
The description states the value at x=5 is approximately 3, but the data point is significantly lower, at approximately 2.2.
The description states the value at x=9 is approximately 1.8, but the data point is lower, at approximately 1.4.
The description states the value at approximately x=13 is close to 0.7, but the data point is at approximately 1.0.
The description uses the vague phrase '某种数值' (some numerical value) to describe the y-axis variable, instead of using the specific label provided on the axis, which is '特征值' (Eigenvalue).
